instruction: Configure Apache with DAVLockDB and DAV On
output:
<think>
Goal: This requires setting up or modifying echo configuration.
The configuration involves multiple parameters — we'll apply them together for consistency.

echo 'Alias /webdav /var/www/webdav

    DAV On
    DAVLockDB /var/www/webdav/DAVLock
    Options Indexes
    AuthType Digest
    AuthName "WebDAV"
    AuthUserFile /etc/apache2/webdav.passwd
    Require valid-user
</Directory>' | sudo tee /etc/apache2/sites-available/webdav.conf

instruction: Configure lighttpd WebDAV with authentication
output:
<think>
Goal: This requires setting up or modifying echo configuration.
The configuration involves multiple parameters — we'll apply them together for consistency.

Plan: I'll use `echo` as the primary tool — echo command execution and management. Pipes pass data between stages without intermediate files, keeping the operation efficient and atomic.

echo '$HTTP["url"] =~ "^/webdav" {

    webdav.log-xml = "enable"
    auth.require = ( "" => ( "method" => "digest", "realm" => "WebDAV", "require" => "valid-user" ) )
}' | sudo tee /etc/lighttpd/conf-available/90-webdav.conf
